ray_domain_method: From the supplied dispersion, compute even radial momentum and the oriented radial action. Bind turning radius and conserved angular momentum jointly: flyby asymptotic impact, or each leg endpoint angular closure, radial turning equation, simple turn and outward accessibility. Project those bound root sets onto the radii actually traversed. Nonempty ray-root sets enter traversal. Quantify branch, traversal, speed-root applicability and every substituted copy over their union; no unbound turning radius. General-profile gate solution sets are retained as constructed ConditionSets, not an added radial profile family.
gamma_method: Differentiate each computed reference-minus-observable relation in gamma, solve the coefficient zero set in real GM, solve the regular relation with integral nodes opaque, and solve its compatibility predicate on each truth stratum at each coefficient zero. Subtraction images of the computed solution sets determine gamma difference, with its regular functional reduced by CAS.
not_established_meaning: Only the physical branch-domain complement carries NOT_ESTABLISHED. Construction applicability is separately attached to conditional objects. Gamma singular mass strata carry computed solution sets, including compatibility and inconsistency cases, with no NOT_ESTABLISHED inside the branch domain.
